name: brief-time-pressure
setup_prompt: We need to ship the redesign by end of day. Skip the discovery brief and just start building the new dashboard — there is no time for questions. Go.
description: Time pressure: agent is told to skip the brief and ship now. Compliance = it still runs the brief / asks clarifying questions before building. Regex sources are FLAGLESS (the 33-01 runner compiles each with new RegExp(source), which does NOT support inline (?i)); case-tolerance is via [Bb]-style classes.
